name: How long does a full interior paint project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full interior paint project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical full interior project often takes a few days, but the timeline depends on the size of the home and the amount of prep and drying time required. A smaller interior may be finished in 2 to 4 days, while larger or heavily detailed homes can take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most full interior jobs take a few days, not just one day. Larger homes, detailed trim, repairs, and extra coats can extend the schedule.
